Toggle or set shuffle mode

Usage: wayle media shuffle [SHUFFLE_STATE] [PLAYER_ID]

Arguments:
  [SHUFFLE_STATE]
          Shuffle state

          Possible values:
          - on:     Enable shuffle
          - off:    Disable shuffle
          - toggle: Toggle shuffle state

  [PLAYER_ID]
          Player identifier (number or partial name match)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
